highlights.en:
In every market the edge goes to the one who has
done the homework the other side skipped.
organize the material before you study it.

Learn the board before you play; study the setups and run a pitch-penny
account before you trade real size.

be quick while the crowd is watching, and stay
humble long after it has moved on.

Build your capital before you spend it, and do not hide
your reserve where someone else decides its value.

Michael did not fight his; he built his whole day around
it. Find the session that suits you, guard your sleep, and the free
hours become part of your edge.

Do not jump straight back in with real money. Replay, predict,
warm up the fingers, then play.

Integrity is not only a virtue;
it can be a business plan.

mindmap.note_en: Stamps, the Green Book, chess and the first book on the Fischer match.
mindmap.note_ar: الطوابع والكتاب الأخضر والشطرنج وأول كتاب عن مباراة Fischer.

children.note_en: Bought misidentified Canadian stamps for $25 and sold for $300.
children.note_ar: اشترى طوابع كندية خطأ التعريف بـ $25 وباعها بـ $300.

children.note_en: The edge goes to whoever did the homework the other side skipped.
children.note_ar: الأفضلية لمن أنجز الواجب الذي أهمله الطرف الآخر.

children.note_en: Typed 400+ pages of Presocratic Fragments with all translations grouped.
children.note_ar: طبع 400+ صفحة من شذرات ما قبل سقراط بجميع ترجماتها مجتمعة.

children.note_en: Put every view side by side and the work goes faster.
children.note_ar: ضع كل وجهات النظر جنبًا إلى جنب فيسرع العمل.

children.note_en: Chess students who studied before playing became better players; most chose to play immediately.
children.note_ar: من درس قبل اللعب صار أقوى؛ وأكثرهم اختار اللعب فورًا.

children.en: Lesson: learn before you trade size
children.note_en: Study setups and use a pitch-penny account before real size.
children.note_ar: ادرس الـ setups واستخدم حسابًا زهيدًا قبل الحجم الحقيقي.

children.note_en: Co-wrote the first book on the Fischer-Spassky match; sold 1200 copies in two weeks.
children.note_ar: شارك في تأليف أول كتاب عن مباراة Fischer-Spassky وباع 1200 نسخة في أسبوعين.

children.note_en: Speed wins the moment; humility keeps you learning.
children.note_ar: السرعة تربح اللحظة والتواضع يبقيك متعلمًا.

mindmap.note_en: The Story of Civilization, Hawaii trading hours, and getting back in the groove.
mindmap.note_ar: قصة الحضارة وساعات التداول في Hawaii والعودة إلى الإيقاع.

children.note_en: Cash hidden in books was sold at a garage sale.
children.note_ar: نقود مخبأة في كتب بيعت في بيع المرآب.

children.en: Lesson: build capital, don't hide reserve
children.note_en: Build capital before spending it; do not let others decide your reserve's value.
children.note_ar: ابنِ رأس المال قبل إنفاقه ولا تدع غيرك يقرر قيمة احتياطيك.

children.note_en: Futures traded about 4am to 11am; he built his day around the clock.
children.note_ar: تداول العقود من نحو 4am إلى 11am؛ وبنى يومه حول الساعة.

children.note_en: Guard your sleep; free hours become part of your edge.
children.note_ar: احرص على نومك فتصير الساعات الحرة جزءًا من أفضليتك.

children.note_en: Review last 3–4 trades step by step, then Ghost Trading for 1–2 days.
children.note_ar: راجع آخر 3–4 صفقات خطوة بخطوة ثم Ghost Trading ليوم أو يومين.

children.note_en: Replay, predict, warm up, then play.
children.note_ar: أعد الشريط وتنبّأ وسخّن ثم العب.

mindmap.note_en: Left a firm that mistreated customers, founded DynexCorp; Michael stayed in touch for almost fifty years.
mindmap.note_ar: ترك شركة تسيء إلى عملائها وأسس DynexCorp؛ وظل Michael على اتصال به قرابة خمسين عامًا.

children.note_en: A career can begin with a refusal; integrity can be a business plan.
children.note_ar: قد تبدأ المسيرة برفض؛ والنزاهة قد تكون خطة عمل.
